notes.title: Build 14933265 is now live
notes.content:
HAPPY FREEDOM DAY GAMERS! 

Before I log off for the day and go fishing, here's a great new update for you all! 

Allen has been added to the game and I need you all to fight him!

To access the boss rush room, simply follow these simple steps.

[olist]
[*] Load your save file of choice. 
[*] Open the debug menu and press the L key on your keyboard. 
[/olist]

This take you to the boss test room and gives you a place to save before you fight the boss of your choice. 

Before you fight Allen, Give yourself at least 6 health, buff you attack stats up to 2 or more, and give yourself an extra reserve take if you want. 

I look forward to seeing the footage of your fights! Happy playing!

notes.title: Diamond Trio - Laurenza Update! (Build-14268199)
notes.content:
Hello, playtesters! Thank you so much for your generous help through the MM PP! 
It's been a fun week seeing everyone play Mole Maiden, and discovering all the bugs peppered through the game! 

Starting this now, the game has been updated to Alpha 4 version 21 and features the newest member of the Diamond Trio, Laurenza. The Diamond Trio are three strong bosses you must face back-to-back before you can fight the Champion Coppra. 

Your mission this week is to stress test this boss's AI and experiment with how to defeat her. 

[h2]Before you Fight[/h2]
Before you fight, please make sure that you are properly equipt with the equipment needed to test the boss's difficulty.  Before facing the boss, press the zero key on your keyboard to open the Debug menu.  Follow the on-screen prompts and equip the following. 
[list]
[*]Number of Hearts: between 6 and 8
[*] Attack buff: 2-4
[*] Equip all abilities. 
[/list]

To reach Laurenza, open your debug menu and press '/' to warp to the Quartz Pyramid. Talk to the nurse to save your game, and then head right to and enter the giant doorway. Once inside the trio maze, go up and to the right. 

If you have any questions, please feel fee to ask me in #playtest-general. Looking forward to seeing your feedback this week! 

- Cheers

notes.title: Playtest Patch 05-01-2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Playtest Program for Mole Maiden. 

A quick update has been made to the game's Main Menu to include a scannable QR code that takes you to a detailed instruction manual on how to properly log playtest data. 

In addition to this, here are some other fixes:
[list]
[*] it should no longer be possible to pause the game while talking to an NPC. 
[*] The Laurenza boss fight has been added to the game. If you want a sneak peek before her assigned playtest week, please use the Debug menu and warp to the Quartz Pyramid. 
[/list]

Thank you so much for taking part in this program! Looking forward to hearing your feedback!
